items.name: file-input
items.title: File input
items.description: File selector with a button and a drop zone: multiple, accept, maxSize, a removable file list, sizes formatted with Intl, keyboard operable, drag-over state, and live-region announcements. Required validation focuses the button and shows a message; window drop guard, paste, maxFiles, per-file status bar, clear all, form reset.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. The button opens the native input type=file, so Enter and Space work. Dropped or chosen files that do not match accept or exceed maxSize are rejected with a role=alert message. Removing a file keeps the native input's FileList in sync through DataTransfer. Migration (v4): the native input is visually hidden (sr-only, tabIndex -1, aria-hidden) instead of display:none, so `required` is validated and `invalid` focuses the button and shows `requiredMessage`. While mounted, file dragovers/drops anywhere on the window are cancelled so a miss does not navigate away. Paste inside the group adds clipboard files. New props: maxFiles, status(file, index) -> {state, progress}, requiredMessage, clearLabel. Rejection messages now accumulate until 모두 지우기 or a form reset (they used to be replaced by each drop). Form reset empties the list.
